description: Run a command under FULL Supervisor Mode. Iteratively executes the command, checks quality gates, and returns fix packets until PASS or max retries reached. Use this for self-healing agent loops.

command.description: The agent command to run (e.g., 'claude "fix the bug"', 'aider --message "refactor auth"').

cwd.description: Absolute path to the project root.

dryRun.description: If true, simulates the loop without executing the command. Useful for testing gate checks.

name: rigour_run_supervised
